label: Expired token
description: Manual negative case: send a bearer token after its five-minute lifetime and confirm the token is rejected.
notes: This case is intentionally manual. The harness does not persist a token or sleep for five minutes, and the staff draft does not establish an exact HTTP status.
rationale: Confirms one documented failure boundary from a known-good request.
constraints: Apply exactly one named mutation immediately before transport.

provenance.source: SHN Connectathon Test Process 2026-10-14 staff draft; SHN Provider Test Endpoint guide
